# Wolin (月印千江) — Complete Zero-Hallucination Developer Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Canonical Reference URL: `https://wolin.id/llms-full.txt`
> Concise Index: `https://wolin.id/llms.txt`
> Docs MCP Endpoint: `https://wolin.id/mcp`
> Copy-Paste Prompt Hub: `https://wolin.id/prompts.html`
> Standards: W3C Solid Protocol 0.11 · W3C Solid-OIDC · RFC 9449 DPoP (`ES256`) · RFC 7638 JWK Thumbprint · W3C RDF 1.1 Turtle / JSON-LD · WAC & ACP

---

## 0. Architecture & Core Endpoints at a Glance

- **Canonical Solid-OIDC Issuer**: `https://auth.wolin.id` (Discovery: `https://auth.wolin.id/.well-known/openid-configuration`)
- **User WebID Format**: `https://{handle}.wolin.id/profile/card#me`
- **User Sovereign Pod Root (`pim:storage`)**: `https://{handle}.wolin.id/` (origin-isolated subdomain) or `https://pod.wolin.cloud/{handle}/`
- **Wolin Passport Showcase**: Navigating a browser (`Accept: text/html`) to `https://{handle}.wolin.id` renders the user's 3D avatar card and world links; querying with `Accept: text/turtle` returns the standard W3C WebID RDF profile.
- **Zero Backend Required for Worlds**: Static web worlds (Vite / Next.js / React Three Fiber / Unity WebGL) deploy for `$0/mo` on Cloudflare Pages. Authentication uses a static `client-id.jsonld` file, and persistent state lives inside each player's Wolin Pod.

### 0.1 Data Boundary Rule: User Pod vs. Your Authoritative Server (CRITICAL)
Because users hold read/write ownership over their own Pod (`PUT`/`PATCH`), **never store cheat-sensitive game economy or progression directly in a Pod as authoritative truth**:

| Store in **User Pod** (`https://{handle}.wolin.id`) | Store in **Your Authoritative Game/App Server** |
|---|---|
| Profiles, display names, avatar GLB/skins, portal bookmarks | XP, levels, combat stats, quest state |
| User-generated content (UGC: notes, wish lanterns, photos, room builds) | In-game currency, gold, balances, tradeable item ledgers |
| **Server-signed badges, achievements & tickets** (verifiable across worlds) | Leaderboards, rankings, win/loss records, anti-cheat state |

---

## 1. 5-Language SDK 10-Line Quickstarts

All 5 official Wolin SDKs implement RFC 9449 `ES256` (NIST P-256) DPoP proof signing, RFC 7638 `cnf.jkt` thumbprints, automatic `DPoP-Nonce` retry, W3C WebID `pim:storage` discovery, and `ETag` (`If-Match` / `If-None-Match`) optimistic concurrency with **zero third-party cryptography bloat**.

### 1.1 TypeScript / JavaScript (`@wolin-id/client` & `@wolin-id/react`)
- **Repo**: `https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-js`
- **Install**: `pnpm add @wolin-id/client @wolin-id/react`

```ts
import { WolinPodClient, fetchWebIdProfile, generateDPoPKeyPair } from '@wolin-id/client';

const profile = await fetchWebIdProfile('https://alice.wolin.id/profile/card#me');
const dpopKeyPair = await generateDPoPKeyPair(); // Web Crypto non-extractable P-256
const pod = new WolinPodClient({
  podUrl: profile.primaryStorage,
  webId: profile.webId,
  accessToken: tokens.accessToken, // DPoP-bound token from exchangeCodeForTokens()
  dpopKeyPair,
});
const current = await pod.getResource('/private/notes.ttl');
await pod.putResource('/private/notes.ttl', '<#n1> <https://wolin.id/ns#displayName> "Alice" .', {
  ifMatch: current.etag ?? undefined,
});
```

**React 18 / 19 Hook Quickstart (`@wolin-id/react`)**:
```tsx
import { WolinProvider, usePodResource, useWolinSession } from '@wolin-id/react';

export const App = () => (
  <WolinProvider clientId={`${location.origin}/client-id.jsonld`} redirectUri={`${location.origin}/auth/callback`} defaultOidcIssuer="https://auth.wolin.id">
    <WorldHud />
  </WolinProvider>
);

function WorldHud() {
  const { isAuthenticated, session, login, logout } = useWolinSession();
  const { data, save } = usePodResource(isAuthenticated ? '/private/world-save.ttl' : null);
  return isAuthenticated
    ? <button onClick={() => void save('<#save> <https://wolin.id/ns#score> 42 .')}>Save ({session?.webId})</button>
    : <button onClick={() => void login()}>Continue with Wolin</button>;
}
```

### 1.2 Unity C# (`id.wolin.unity` — Unity 2022.3+ / `.NET Standard 2.1`)
- **Repo**: `https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-unity`
- **Install (`Packages/manifest.json`)**: `"id.wolin.unity": "https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-unity.git#v0.1.0"`

```csharp
using System;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Wolin.Unity;

using var client = new WolinClient();
client.SetAccessToken(accessToken, "https://alice.wolin.id/profile/card#me");
Uri storageRoot = await client.DiscoverStorageAsync("https://alice.wolin.id/profile/card#me");
Uri saveUri = new Uri(storageRoot, "games/indie-lobby/save.ttl");
PodResource loaded = await client.GetAsync(saveUri);
await client.PutAsync(saveUri, "<#player> <https://wolin.id/ns#level> 7 .", "text/turtle", ifMatch: loaded.ETag);
```

### 1.3 Swift 6 (`WolinKit` — iOS 16+ / macOS 13+ / visionOS 1+)
- **Repo**: `https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-swift`
- **Install (`Package.swift`)**: `.package(url: "https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-swift.git", from: "0.1.0")` (`product: "WolinKit"`)

```swift
import CryptoKit
import WolinKit

let signer = DPoPSigner(privateKey: P256.Signing.PrivateKey())
let client = WolinClient(accessToken: token, webID: "https://alice.wolin.id/profile/card#me", dpopSigner: signer)
let storageURL = try await client.discoverStorage()
let noteURL = storageURL.appending(path: "private/notes.ttl")
let resource = try await client.getResource(at: noteURL)
if let etag = resource.etag {
    try await client.putTurtle(at: noteURL, turtle: "<#me> <https://wolin.id/ns#displayName> \"Alice\" .", etagMatch: .ifMatch(etag))
}
```

### 1.4 Kotlin / Android / JVM (`id.wolin:sdk-kotlin` — Kotlin 2.1+ / JVM 17+)
- **Repo**: `https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-kotlin`
- **Install (`build.gradle.kts`)**: `implementation("id.wolin:sdk-kotlin:0.1.0")`

```kotlin
import id.wolin.sdk.DPoPSigner
import id.wolin.sdk.WolinClient

val signer = DPoPSigner.generate()
val client = WolinClient(accessToken = token, dpopSigner = signer)
val storageRoot = client.discoverStorage("https://alice.wolin.id/profile/card#me")
val noteUrl = client.resolveResourceUrl(storageRoot, "private/notes.ttl")
val current = client.get(noteUrl)
client.put(url = noteUrl, body = "<#it> <https://wolin.id/ns#displayName> \"Alice\" .", ifMatch = current.etag)
```

### 1.5 Python 3.11+ (`wolin-id` — Async `httpx`)
- **Repo**: `https://github.com/wolin-id/sdk-python`
- **Install**: `pip install wolin-id`

```python
import os
from wolin_id import DpopSigner, WolinClient

async def sync_pod() -> None:
    async with WolinClient("https://pod.wolin.cloud", access_token=os.environ["WOLIN_ACCESS_TOKEN"], dpop_signer=DpopSigner.generate()) as client:
        profile = await client.fetch_webid_profile("https://alice.wolin.id/profile/card#me")
        note_url = f"{profile.primary_storage}private/note.ttl"
        res = await client.get(note_url)
        await client.put(note_url, '<#it> <https://wolin.id/ns#displayName> "Alice" .\n', content_type="text/turtle", if_match=res.etag)
```

## 2. Solid-OIDC Client ID Document (`client-id.jsonld`) — Zero App Review

Wolin eliminates OAuth client secrets, developer portal registration, and manual app review. Host this static JSON-LD file at `https://<your-domain>/client-id.jsonld` (`public/client-id.jsonld` in Vite / Next.js) and pass its full URL as `clientId`.

### Copy-Paste `public/client-id.jsonld`
```json
{
  "@context": "https://www.w3.org/ns/solid/oidc-context.jsonld",
  "client_id": "https://world.example.com/client-id.jsonld",
  "client_name": "My Wolin 3D World",
  "client_uri": "https://world.example.com",
  "logo_uri": "https://world.example.com/icon-192.png",
  "redirect_uris": [
    "https://world.example.com/auth/callback"
  ],
  "post_logout_redirect_uris": [
    "https://world.example.com/"
  ],
  "grant_types": [
    "authorization_code",
    "refresh_token"
  ],
  "response_types": [
    "code"
  ],
  "token_endpoint_auth_method": "none",
  "scope": "openid webid offline_access"
}
```

### Mandatory `client-id.jsonld` Invariants
1. **Strict Origin Binding**: `new URL(client_id).origin` **MUST** equal `new URL(redirect_uri).origin`. Cross-origin `redirect_uri` values are rejected by `https://auth.wolin.id/authorize` with `invalid_request` to prevent client spoofing.
2. **PKCE `S256` Required**: `code_challenge_method=S256` and `response_type=code` are mandatory (`token_endpoint_auth_method: "none"`).
3. **CORS & Content-Type (`public/_headers` on Cloudflare Pages)**:
   ```text
   /client-id.jsonld
     Content-Type: application/ld+json; charset=utf-8
     Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *
   ```
4. **Local Development**: During local dev (`http://localhost:5173`), serve `/client-id.jsonld` dynamically or from `public/` with `"client_id": "http://localhost:5173/client-id.jsonld"` and `"redirect_uris": ["http://localhost:5173/auth/callback"]`.

---

## 3. Official Metaverse & Passport RDF Vocabulary (`https://wolin.id/ns#`)

All cross-world Wolin apps share the canonical `https://wolin.id/ns#` (`PREFIX wolin: <https://wolin.id/ns#>`) vocabulary alongside W3C `foaf:`, `pim:`, `solid:`, `ldp:`, and `schema:`. Do **not** invent ad-hoc avatar predicates; use these exact IRIs so avatars and wearables travel seamlessly across every Wolin-enabled world.

### 3.1 Core Predicates & Classes

| Term (`wolin:*`) | Full IRI | Range / Type | Purpose |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| `wolin:displayName` | `https://wolin.id/ns#displayName` | `xsd:string` | Canonical cross-world 3D nametag & Passport display name (falls back to `foaf:name`). |
| `wolin:avatarGlbUrl` | `https://wolin.id/ns#avatarGlbUrl` | `xsd:anyURI` | glTF 2.0 binary (`.glb`) 3D avatar URL for Three.js / R3F / Unity / Vision Pro worlds. |
| `wolin:avatarVrmUrl` | `https://wolin.id/ns#avatarVrmUrl` | `xsd:anyURI` | VRM 0.x / 1.0 (`.vrm`) humanoid avatar URL with blendshapes & spring bones for VTuber worlds. |
| `wolin:worldLinks` | `https://wolin.id/ns#worldLinks` | `wolin:WorldLink` | Links a user's WebID (`#me`) to favorite or hosted 3D worlds & social portals shown on Wolin Passport. |
| `wolin:wearableItem` | `https://wolin.id/ns#wearableItem` | `wolin:Wearable` | Links `#me` or `/public/inventory.ttl` to portable 3D wearable items owned/equipped by the user. |
| `wolin:passportTheme` | `https://wolin.id/ns#passportTheme` | `xsd:string` | Optional Passport theme / accent token (e.g. `"cobalt-220"`). |

**Supporting `wolin:WorldLink` & `wolin:Wearable` Properties**:
- On `wolin:WorldLink`: `schema:name` (`xsd:string`), `schema:url` (`xsd:anyURI`, `http:`/`https:` only), `wolin:linkKind` (`"world"` or `"social"`).
- On `wolin:Wearable`: `schema:name` (`xsd:string`), `wolin:assetGlbUrl` (`xsd:anyURI`), `wolin:slot` (`"hat"` | `"accessory"` | `"outfit"` | `"companion"`), `wolin:equipped` (`xsd:boolean`).

### 3.2 Canonical WebID Profile Turtle Example (`/profile/card`)

```turtle
@prefix foaf:   <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> .
@prefix pim:    <http://www.w3.org/ns/pim/space#> .
@prefix solid:  <http://www.w3.org/ns/solid/terms#> .
@prefix ldp:    <http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#> .
@prefix schema: <https://schema.org/> .
@prefix xsd:    <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .
@prefix wolin:  <https://wolin.id/ns#> .

<> a foaf:PersonalProfileDocument ;
   foaf:maker <#me> ;
   foaf:primaryTopic <#me> .

<#me> a foaf:Person ;
   foaf:name "Alice Kim" ;
   wolin:displayName "Alice" ;
   solid:oidcIssuer <https://auth.wolin.id> ;
   pim:storage </> ;
   ldp:inbox </inbox/> ;
   wolin:passportTheme "cobalt-220" ;
   wolin:avatarGlbUrl <https://cdn.wolin.id/pods/alice/public/avatar.glb> ;
   wolin:avatarVrmUrl <https://cdn.wolin.id/pods/alice/public/avatar.vrm> ;
   wolin:worldLinks <#link-cat-cafe>, <#link-concert> ;
   wolin:wearableItem <#item-beret> .

<#link-cat-cafe> a wolin:WorldLink ;
   schema:name "Alice's Cozy Cat Cafe" ;
   schema:url <https://catcafe.pages.dev/> ;
   wolin:linkKind "world" .

<#link-concert> a wolin:WorldLink ;
   schema:name "Friday VTuber Stage" ;
   schema:url <https://vtuber-stage.pages.dev/> ;
   wolin:linkKind "world" .

<#item-beret> a wolin:Wearable ;
   schema:name "Cobalt Artist Beret" ;
   wolin:assetGlbUrl <https://cdn.wolin.id/pods/alice/public/wearables/beret.glb> ;
   wolin:slot "hat" ;
   wolin:equipped true .
```

## 4. The 4 Metaverse Lego Blocks

Scaffold all 4 blocks together with `pnpm create wolin-world my-world` (`https://github.com/wolin-id/metaverse-starter`), or compose them individually in any Three.js / React Three Fiber app.

### Block 1: Passwordless Login + Portable GLB / VRM Avatar Spawn
Dereference the signed-in player's WebID profile, extract `wolin:avatarGlbUrl` (or `wolin:avatarVrmUrl`) and `wolin:displayName`, and spawn their 3D avatar with a zero-crash procedural fallback when unset.

```tsx
import { Suspense, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { useGLTF, Html } from '@react-three/drei';
import { fetchWebIdProfile, parseTurtle } from '@wolin-id/client';
import { useWolinSession } from '@wolin-id/react';

const WOLIN = 'https://wolin.id/ns#';

export function PlayerAvatar({ position = [0, 0, 0] as [number, number, number] }) {
  const { session } = useWolinSession();
  const [avatarUrl, setAvatarUrl] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState('Guest');

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session?.webId) return;
    fetch(session.webId, { headers: { Accept: 'text/turtle' } })
      .then((r) => r.text())
      .then((ttl) => {
        const triples = parseTurtle(ttl, session.webId);
        const glb = triples.find((t) => t.predicate === `${WOLIN}avatarGlbUrl`)?.object;
        const label = triples.find((t) => t.predicate === `${WOLIN}displayName`)?.object;
        if (glb) setAvatarUrl(glb);
        if (label) setName(label);
      });
  }, [session?.webId]);

  return (
    <group position={position}>
      <Html position={[0, 2.1, 0]} center distanceFactor={8}>
        <span style={{ background: '#171717', color: '#fff', padding: '2px 8px', borderRadius: 999, fontSize: 12 }}>{name}</span>
      </Html>
      <Suspense fallback={<FallbackCapsule />}>
        {avatarUrl ? <GlbModel url={avatarUrl} /> : <FallbackCapsule />}
      </Suspense>
    </group>
  );
}

function GlbModel({ url }: { url: string }) {
  const { scene } = useGLTF(url);
  return <primitive object={scene} />;
}

function FallbackCapsule() {
  return (
    <mesh position={[0, 0.9, 0]}>
      <capsuleGeometry args={[0.35, 1.1, 8, 16]} />
      <meshStandardMaterial color="#0055FF" />
    </mesh>
  );
}
```

### Block 2: `$0` YouTube / CHZZK `CSS3DRenderer` Live Stage + P2P Spatial Voice
- **Broadcast Video (`$0` Egress)**: Never transcode or relay 1080p broadcast video through your own server when embedding public livestreams. Mount a YouTube Live (`https://www.youtube.com/embed/<VIDEO_ID>?autoplay=1&mute=0`) or CHZZK (`https://chzzk.naver.com/live/<CHANNEL_ID>`) `<iframe>` onto a 3D stage plane via Three.js `CSS3DRenderer` (`CSS3DObject` or `@react-three/drei` `<Html transform occlude>`). All video CDN egress is paid by YouTube / CHZZK.
- **Proximity Spatial Voice (`$0` for 1–4 Peers)**: Connect nearby players via `RTCPeerConnection` (`stun:stun.cloudflare.com:3478`) and pipe remote `MediaStream` tracks into Web Audio API `AudioContext -> MediaStreamAudioSourceNode -> PannerNode (panningModel = 'HRTF', refDistance = 2, maxDistance = 18)` updated in `useFrame` from avatar positions. For 5+ concurrent speakers, bridge through Cloudflare Realtime SFU.

```tsx
import { Html } from '@react-three/drei';

export function LiveConcertScreen({ embedUrl }: { embedUrl: string }) {
  return (
    <group position={[0, 3.6, -12]}>
      <mesh>
        <planeGeometry args={[9.8, 5.6]} />
        <meshStandardMaterial color="#171717" />
      </mesh>
      <Html transform distanceFactor={4} position={[0, 0, 0.02]}>
        <iframe
          src={embedUrl}
          width={960}
          height={540}
          allow="autoplay; encrypted-media; picture-in-picture"
          style={{ border: '1px solid #E5E5E5', borderRadius: 8, background: '#000' }}
          title="Wolin Live Stage"
        />
      </Html>
    </group>
  );
}
```

### Block 3: Sovereign Zero-PII Spatial Monetization (`<WolinAdSlot />`)
Monetize 3D worlds without tracking cookies or leaking personal data. `<WolinAdSlot />` matches creatives strictly on **world spatial context** (`worldTheme`) and **optional user-declared interests**, delivering `.glb` props or `16:9` / `2:3` poster textures from Cloudflare R2 CDN (`60–70%` revenue share to the world host).

```tsx
import { WolinAdSlot } from '@wolin-id/metaverse-starter';

// Drop anywhere inside a <Canvas>:
<WolinAdSlot
  slotId="cafe-wall-poster-01"
  format="poster-2x3"
  worldTheme="cozy-cat-cafe"
  position={[4.2, 2.0, -3.5]}
  rotation={[0, -Math.PI / 2, 0]}
  fallbackHouseAd={true}
/>
```

**Built-in 3D Viewability Invariants (Do Not Bypass)**:
- Valid viewability (`vCPM`) fires **only** when: (1) inside active `PerspectiveCamera` frustum, (2) center + corner raycasts pass with zero wall occlusion, (3) projected screen area `>= 5%`, (4) continuous dwell time `>= 1500ms` verified against server-issued `impression_token`, and (5) local user input occurred within the last `30s` (anti-AFK farming). Gaze checks stay 100% in browser RAM and are never sent to any server.

### Block 4: 1-Click Cloudflare Pages Static World Deploy
Because authentication (`https://auth.wolin.id`) and user storage (`https://{handle}.wolin.id/`) are externalized to Wolin, your 3D world is 100% static HTML/JS/WASM/GLB assets with `$0` backend compute:

```bash
# 1. Scaffold starter with client-id.jsonld + _headers preconfigured
pnpm create wolin-world my-world
cd my-world

# 2. Build static bundle (sets client_id origin from VITE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN)
VITE_PUBLIC_ORIGIN="https://my-world.pages.dev" pnpm build

# 3. Deploy globally to Cloudflare Pages in 1 command
npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=my-world --branch=main
```

## 5. Common Pitfall Prevention Rules (Mandatory Guardrails)

Coding agents integrating Wolin or raw W3C Solid HTTP endpoints **MUST** obey these three protocol rules to avoid `401`, `405`, and `412` runtime errors.

### Rule 1: RFC 9449 DPoP `ath` SHA-256 Hash & `htu` Normalization
- **Never send a DPoP-bound token with `Authorization: Bearer`**: Use `Authorization: DPoP <access_token>` paired with `DPoP: <proof_jwt>`.
- **Mandatory `ath` Claim on Resource Requests**: Whenever an `access_token` is sent, the DPoP proof JWT payload **MUST** contain `"ath"` equal to the **unpadded Base64URL encoding of the raw SHA-256 digest of the ASCII `access_token` bytes**:
  ```ts
  // CORRECT: unpadded Base64URL(SHA-256(ASCII(accessToken))) -> 43 chars
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(accessToken));
  const ath = btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(digest)))
    .replace(/\+/g, '-').replace(/\//g, '_').replace(/=+$/, '');
  ```
  - **WRONG**: Hex-encoded SHA-256 (`64` hex chars), Base64 with `=` padding, or omitting `ath` after token exchange.
- **Strict `htu` Normalization**: Strip `?query` and `#fragment` from `htu` (`https://alice.wolin.id/private/notes.ttl`, never `...notes.ttl?foo=1#me`). Ensure `alg: "ES256"`, `typ: "dpop+jwt"`, public `jwk` without private `"d"`, and raw 64-byte IEEE P1363 (`R || S`, not ASN.1 DER) signature.
- **Recommendation**: Always use `@wolin-id/client`, `id.wolin.unity`, `WolinKit`, `id.wolin:sdk-kotlin`, or `wolin-id` (`DpopSigner`) instead of hand-rolling JWT signing.

### Rule 2: W3C Solid LDP Trailing Slash (`/`) Container Rule
- **Containers MUST end with `/`**: `/public/`, `/public/worlds/`, `/private/saves/` are `ldp:BasicContainer` URIs.
- **Documents/Files MUST NOT end with `/`**: `/private/saves/slot1.ttl`, `/public/avatar.glb` are `ldp:Resource` (`ldp:RDFSource` or `ldp:NonRDFSource`) URIs.
- **Failure Modes**:
  - `GET /private/saves` (missing `/`) looks up a document named `saves` (`404 Not Found`), whereas `GET /private/saves/` lists `ldp:contains` children of the `saves/` container.
  - `PUT /private/saves/` with file bytes creates/updates a container graph instead of storing a file; `POST /private/saves` (missing `/`) fails with `405 Method Not Allowed`.
- Always call `pod.createContainer('/private/saves/')` and `pod.listContainer('/private/saves/')` for directories, and `pod.putResource('/private/saves/slot1.ttl', ...)` for documents.

### Rule 3: Optimistic Concurrency with `ETag`, `If-Match`, and `If-None-Match: *`
- **Prevent Lost Updates (`If-Match`)**: Every Wolin `GET`, `HEAD`, `PUT`, and `POST` response returns a strong HTTP `ETag` header. Store `etag` alongside state and pass `If-Match: <etag>` on subsequent `PUT`, `PATCH` (`application/sparql-update`), or `DELETE` calls.
- **Prevent Accidental Overwrites (`If-None-Match: *`)**: When initializing a default profile, inventory, or save slot for the first time, pass `If-None-Match: *` (`createOnly: true` in TS/Python, `.createOnly` in Swift, `createIfAbsent` in Kotlin).
- **Handle `412 Precondition Failed` Gracefully**: If another tab or world updated the Pod resource concurrently, Wolin returns `412 Precondition Failed` (`WolinPreconditionError` in `@wolin-id/client`). Catch `412`, re-read the latest resource + `ETag` via `GET`, merge the RDF triples or state, and retry with the fresh `ETag`.

---

## 6. Game & Economy Data Integrity (3-Tier Boundary)

Because users own their Pod, **never store cheat-sensitive economy/combat state as plain user-writable Pod files**. Partition metaverse data into 3 tiers:

1. **Authoritative Game Server DB (Real-Time & Economy)**:
   - Keep real-time coordinates/HP, PvP hit detection, leaderboards, and tradable currencies/consumables in your own game server DB to prevent save-editing and snapshot rollback double-spends.
2. **Issuer-Signed Portable Proofs in Pod (`/badges/*.jsonld` — Tamper-Evident)**:
   - For cross-metaverse achievements, seasonal trophies, or verified cosmetics, have the game server sign a Verifiable Credential / JSON-LD payload with its `Ed25519` private key and write it to the user's Pod. Any user tampering breaks the signature and is rejected (`INVALID_SIGNATURE`) by verifying worlds.
3. **User-Writable Social & Profile Space (`/profile/card`, `/public/*`, `/private/*`)**:
   - Avatar selection (`wolin:avatarGlbUrl`), Passport `worldLinks`, social posts, and single-player preferences belong in the user's Pod with full user control.

---

## 7. Two-Tier Storage Encryption (`/private/*` vs `/vault/*`)

- **`/private/*` (Standard Envelope Encryption)**: Protected at rest on EBS/R2 while supporting SPARQL projection, `.acl` evaluation, and seamless multi-device social login without forcing recovery keys on casual users.
- **`/vault/*` (Opt-in Zero-Knowledge Client E2EE)**: Client SDKs encrypt payloads locally with `AES-256-GCM` / `XChaCha20-Poly1305` (unlocked via WebAuthn Passkey `PRF` + mandatory Recovery Key backup confirmation) before upload. `/vault/wallet.enc` can optionally store embedded EVM/Solana keys for in-world micro-signing.

---

## 8. Local Development (`--in-memory`)

Use the open-core binary or Docker locally for zero-config testing before deploying to Production (`https://pod.wolin.id` / `https://auth.wolin.id`):
- Run `cargo run -p wolin-server -- --in-memory` (or `docker compose up`) on `http://127.0.0.1:4000`.
- Free-tier Production Pods on `wolin.id` cost `$0`, so no separate public testnet/devnet is required.
